_doc.purpose: Single source of truth for world layout. WorldBuilder reads this and places GLBs after ProceduralFactory builds ground/dyke/roads/flare/buildings.
_doc.axis: +X east, -Z north, +Z south, +Y up. Origin at center of dyke compound.
_doc.scaleConvention: Always prefer targetSize (real-world meters of longest axis). Use scale only when the source GLB is at correct unit scale.
_doc.dykeBounds: x in [-40, 30], z in [-25, 25] — owned by ProceduralFactory.buildDyke
_doc.tankPads: Pad A at (-15, -5) r=8, Pad B at (12, -5) r=6 — owned by ProceduralFactory.buildTankPads
_doc.roads: Road 10 at z=30, Road 12 at z=55, Road 15 at x=35, Service at x=-42
_doc.fixedBuildings: Admin at (50, 70) 14x10x6, Fire Station at (45, -45) 16x12x7 — owned by ProceduralFactory.buildBlueBuildings

TANK_FARM_DYKE.description: Inside the dyke. Two storage tanks centered on the procedural pads, plus the manifold piping at the south end where drain channels converge.

DYKE_DRAIN.description: South-west corner of dyke wall: gate valve handwheel for emergency dyke drain.

COOLING_WATER_VALVE.description: Outside east dyke wall: cooling-water inlet valve for tank 101-B (CW-101B).

PROCESS_BACKDROP_NORTH.description: Process plant horizon line beyond the dyke north wall. Distillation column anchors the silhouette; cooling towers and heat exchangers fill the mid-distance; an industrial-plant block fills the deep background.

PIPE_RACK_CORRIDOR.description: Pipe-rack corridor between the dyke north wall and the process backdrop. The green tunnel covered walkway is the NRL signature landmark. The industrial plant sits directly behind it as a dense process backdrop.

placements._note: Doubled-scale process-block backdrop — fills the north horizon behind the column row

ROAD_10_HYDRANT_BAY.description: South kerb of Road 10 — H-28 (closest to fire tank) and H-27, with hose kits, nozzles and traffic cones marking the pickup.

ROAD_12_HYDRANT_BAY.description: South kerb of Road 12 — H-20 with hose kit and nozzles for second-turnout deployment toward 101-B.

PERIMETER_HYDRANTS.description: Extra hydrants around the perimeter so the player always has one in sight (defence-in-depth).

CONTROL_AREA.description: Player's home base. Admin building (procedural) anchors this. Walkie-talkie, MCP, hydrant key and extinguishers are reachable from the south face of the building (player-spawn-side).

FIRE_STATION_BAY.description: Fire station building (procedural at (45, -45)) is where firefighters originate. Apron clear for truck spawn. Old shed adds visual mass to the east.

EAST_PROCESS_CORRIDOR.description: Process equipment running north along the east side of the plant, visible from the dyke east wall and Road 15. Second distillation column + satellite heat exchangers + catwalk connection.

WEST_PROCESS_BACKDROP.description: Heavy process cluster west of the service road, filling the west horizon line. Cooling tower + heat exchanger + maintenance shed.

SUBSTATION_WEST.description: Electrical substation downwind of the tank farm (west). Transformer + diesel backup generator. Chained off with jersey barriers.

WEST_TANK_CLUSTER.description: Chemical tank pair inside the procedural west enclosure. Third smaller tank added for density. Light tower covers both bays.

EAST_TANK_CLUSTER.description: Large oil tank + second smaller tank inside the procedural east enclosure. Pipeline connecting them. Two light towers.

CONTROL_AREA_INTERIOR.description: Control desk inside the admin area — the field panel the operator works from before walking to execute SOPs.

STORAGE_YARD.description: Shipping container stacks south-east of Road 12. Two groups for visual density.

SOUTH_PERIMETER_FILL.description: South end of compound — warehouses, sheds, and marker cones framing the south boundary below Road 12.

PERIMETER_BUILDINGS.description: Perimeter warehouses + derelict shed that fill the horizon on all sides and frame the playable area.

ROAD_BARRIERS.description: Jersey barriers placed only on the FAR kerbs (away from player walking lines) so they channel traffic without blocking the trainee.

NORTH_COLUMN_ROW.description: Dense NRL-style column row running east-west at z -70 to -85. Three distillation columns anchor the skyline; cooling towers flank them; heat exchangers and pipeline manifolds pack the inter-column gaps, connected by elevated catwalks.

NW_DEEP_PROCESS.description: Far north-west process quad (x -55 to -82, z -38 to -82). Two cooling towers bracket a distillation column; two oil tanks sit behind them; pipe runs and exchangers fill the gaps. Abandoned warehouse closes the north-west corner.

NE_DEEP_PROCESS.description: Far north-east process quad (x 62 to 80, z -30 to -82). Mirrors the NW cluster: one tall distillation column, cooling tower, two oil tanks, heat exchangers, pipe runs. Abandoned warehouse closes the corner.

CENTRAL_MID_PROCESS.description: Mid-facility process density at z -42 to -62. Catwalks bridge the gaps between the column row and the pipe-rack corridor; heat exchangers and pipeline manifolds pack the interstitial space.

FAR_SOUTH_MISC.description: Far south perimeter filling — maintenance sheds, extra warehouse and chemical storage that frame the south boundary beyond the admin-and-hydrant zone.
